# AudioEnhancerMAX

> Free, open-source local audio editing for Apple Silicon Macs. Created by Fabrizio Degni. Canonical product website: https://www.fabriziodegni.com/AudioEnhancerMAX/

## Product facts

Reviewed 2026-10-27. Direct release 3.9.0, build 3.9.2, targets Apple Silicon (arm64) and macOS 13 or later. Free download; MIT license. The direct DMG is Developer ID signed, Apple notarized and stapled. This does not establish Mac App Store approval.

Core DSP and local Whisper transcription run on the Mac. Models may download on first use. Optional Microsoft Edge Neural TTS sends submitted text to Microsoft; Ollama assistance is a separate local helper; Android workers are an optional experimental trusted-LAN boundary. Engine availability varies by installation. Personal Voice Studio is development work, not a promised feature of the stable DMG.

Supported workflows include speech cleanup, reviewed transcript-based cuts and mutes, non-destructive edit history, delivery profiles, processing reports and revision-bound Project Capsules. Loudness checks and provenance hashes do not certify audio quality, transcription accuracy, consent or compliance. Listen to the result before accepting it.

Music brief in stable 3.9.0 prepares editable structured text prompts from six presets, with separate lyrics and JSON export. It does not generate music. Optional local Ollama suggestions require permission and review. Drafts are session-only. Earlier Experimental 1 remains a separate preview installation.
